title: RequestValidationResult
description: Output of the validate_request MCP tool: whether the incoming request parses as JSON and satisfies the caller's JSON Schema. When it does not, `error` is a ready error envelope that names the request's own fields, for a workflow to return as its answer.

email_id.description: The request's identifier at id_pointer; null when the request is unreadable or has none.

message.description: One sentence naming the first problems.

field.description: The request field as the caller writes it, e.g. email.categories[0].description; 'request' for the whole request.

problem.description: missing, empty, not allowed, must be a <type>, must match <pattern>, not valid JSON: ...
